unit_text: On Tuesday I reread Nora's email about the mediation and printed the calendar invite.
I kept wondering whether she was warning me or documenting me.
By the time I got to the meeting with Omar, my jaw was tight.
I admitted I still hadn't called the contractor and apologized for going blank during last week's site visit.

On the bus home I read the note about the leak again, then read it again, and kept hearing Omar say, "just send the estimate." Before sleep I opened the draft reply to Nora, deleted one sentence, restored it, and still didn't know whether the reply was for Nora, for Omar, or just for me.
